decision_conditions: The use hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0cm; line-height: normal;">The overnight use hereby permitted shall be between the
hours of 16:30 and 8:30 for a maximum of five people, including 1 staff member.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><o:p></o:p></span></font></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0cm; line-height: normal;">The premises shall only be used for the purposes
specified in the application and shall not be used for any other purpose,
including any other purpose in Classes F/C2 of the Schedule to the Town and
Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 (or in revoking and re-enacting that
order).<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><o:p></o:p></span></font></p>
description: Change of use from mixed use day centre (Use Class D1) for 40 users and 7 staff (adults with special needs) (Day use) and overnight use (respite care Use Class C2) )7 days per week 16:30hrs to 8:30hrs for 5 people and 1 member of staff to learning centre for people with special educational needs age 7-25 (Use Class F1a) for 40 users (adults with special needs) operating 6 days per week 8:30 to 16:30hrs and overnight use (respite care Use Class C2) 7 days per week 16:30hrs to 8:30hrs for 5 people and 1 member of staff
